summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K furnishing four exhibits: a subsidiary's lease of right-of-use office assets from its parent, an investor conference notice, and September 2026 operating results. The 2026/10/08 board-approved related-party leases total NT$12,192,828, with right-of-use assets of NT$10,824,724 at average monthly rents of NT$680.97 to NT$2,098.09 per ping across Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung and Kaohsiung. This is ordinary-course leasing and disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, M&A mechanics or risk-arb angle apply.
